verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own materials list an 'Automations' product and say you can 'Trigger workflows from ClickUp events', so event-triggered automation is a first-party capability. The evidence is only a pair of one-line marketing and docs mentions, with nothing on how rules are defined, which triggers, conditions or actions exist, or how deep the feature goes. Missing for 10: documented rule builder (triggers/conditions/actions), list of supported event types, AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
